description: A shell script for building and preparing Linux kernel images and modules, including copying prebuilts, generating info files, and packaging for certification, used in Android build environment.

methods.name: prepare_lz4
methods.description: Prepares the LZ4 compression tool if not present.

methods.name: prepare_kernel_image
methods.description: Copies and prepares kernel images for different architectures and build variants.

methods.name: prepare_kernel_modules
methods.description: Copies kernel module prebuilts into the staging directory.

methods.name: update_kernel_prebuilts_with_artifact
methods.description: Updates the kernel prebuilts with the latest built artifacts.

methods.name: update_kernel_module_prebuilts_with_artifact
methods.description: Updates kernel module prebuilts with local staging directory modules.

methods.name: pack_boot_for_certification
methods.description: Packages boot images into a zip file for certification.
